description: This file contains automated tests for the LDAPUserSyncAPI class within the OrangeHRM project. It defines multiple test cases to verify LDAP user synchronization functionalities, including creating, fetching, and configuring LDAP synchronization settings, as well as handling various LDAP configurations and statuses.

classes.name: LDAPUserSyncAPITest
